allocation.question: Can a non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task bank be certified arithmetically before freeze - cold/retrieval comparators demonstrably below ceiling at high novelty, a real treatment/comparator distinction, and honest per-condition counters - and be delivered as a reusable substrate that unblocks the flagship inheritance tests, rather than another mandatory-discovery REST certificate that only re-validates the existing measurement harness?
allocation.rationale: This is the active PREFREEZE mandate EXP-RUNTIME-38046502948 and it is the single highest-leverage Runtime move: the non-degenerate bank (readiness condition 2) is the shared prerequisite whose absence is being re-discovered as MEASUREMENT_INVALID in graph, frontier and product alike, so repairing it once in Runtime removes a whole failure family instead of paying for it repeatedly. Cognitive reset: with the strongest local-trap signature (claim_streak 68, dominant-claim concentration 10/10), a freshly-contexted Runtime would notice that C-MEAS-VALID has become a self-justifying micro-specialty and would ask what substrate other lanes are blocked on; the answer is the B2 bank, which is precisely the active mandate, so the mandate wins after reset.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Program state: all six scientific lanes are ACTIVE on the 2026-10-10 pulse (five PREFREEZE, one FROZEN); none is idle, stalled-before-freeze, or terminated, so the zero-contribution risk this cycle is not inactivity but entrenchment. The decisive missing artifact is still the end-to-end inheritance chain: SPIDER has not yet shown that an inherited compiled mechanism reduces a later agent's residual novelty/exploration cost on a real Web task, so the program's core promise is undemonstrated. The three named readiness conditions currently form the unique critical path and none holds: (1) no SHIPPED parameterized carrier with an executable inherited mechanism plus a known-negative refusal (Product mandate); (2) the task bank lacks non-ceiling cold/retrieval dynamic range and a treatment/comparator distinction (Runtime mandate); (3) no proven same-model credential-free driver for the minimal multi-step Web-agent capability test (Intel mandate). Per the Director readiness rule I am therefore NOT funding any expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON four-arm execution; I keep Product/Runtime/Intel on blocker removal. Graph, Physics and Frontier carry the mechanism-side uncertainty. Tunnel flags on graph, runtime and physics are real but each flagged lane, after a genuine cognitive reset, still lands on its active mandate on the merits: runtime's mandate deliberately redirects accumulated C-MEAS-VALID attention away from a self-justifying micro-specialty onto a cross-cutting blocker; physics's active experiment is FROZEN and must complete under its frozen design; graph's mandate is a cheap, terminal constructibility certificate with a pre-authorized loud-failure redirect. Cross-cutting MEASUREMENT_INVALID families (C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE V9 code-binding, C-FRESHNESS GATE-C3 session isolation, frontier empty sampling frame, product dynamic-range certificate) are being consolidated: the now-fixed freezer/code-binding defect removes the shared cause on two of them, and Runtime's B2 bank is the single repair that stops the non-degenerate-frame failure being re-discovered across graph, frontier and product. I am continuing all six lanes; no lane warrants PARK/TERMINATE because each holds a live, decision-changing question and no lane warrants PIVOT this cycle because each active mandate, re-derived from today's Codex, still wins over the alternatives I evaluated.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout brief materially shaped the decision and was treated as staff advice, not authority. It correctly identified the B1/B2/B3 prerequisites as the true critical path and flagged local entrenchment in runtime/graph/physics; both were confirmed against the Codex snapshot and drove the readiness-rule discipline above. I accepted its framing that the repeated failures are upstream/prerequisite problems rather than scientific negatives. I declined two Scout suggestions on the evidence: (a) its recommendation to reopen C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE as a bounded prerequisite repair, because the portfolio audit argues it should be parked and it is not on the critical path while a parameterized carrier is the live resolve surface; (b) its recommendation to force a mechanism-level escalation on the C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY thread, because the active Frontier mandate already repairs the empty-sampling-frame defect and tests a genuinely orthogonal site-native discovery channel, so an additional orthogonal pivot would spend a cycle before the current decisive test returns. I also recorded, but did not fund this cycle, the Scout's external-landscape point that Stagehand-style auto-caching, workflow-compilation and agent-workflow-memory baselines raise the bar SPIDER must clear; that is a deferred competitor-baseline verification, subordinate to resolving condition (3), not a reason to redirect Intel now.
